args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to production) failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback completed successfully; monitoring for recovery.

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were the last healthy production releases; v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging, and v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. Rollout completed successfully.
3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: The rollback to v2.3.0 was a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
